items.q: Which spelling is correct: “อนุญาต” or “อนุญาติ” (permit)?
items.a: The correct spelling is “อนุญาต”, without the vowel ิ (sara i) on ต

items.q: What should I do if I cannot find a word in the dictionary?
items.a: You can send a question through the academic information inquiry form on the Academic Services page

items.q: Can content from the dictionary be reused?
items.a: Printing or commercial distribution requires prior permission. See the procedure on the Academic Services page
